note: Pulled from the public VHF Google Calendar ICS feed (sources/calendar/index.mjs), windowed to the next 120 days. Entries matching content/events-exclude.json (closures, internal volunteer shifts, cancelled/private items) are dropped; everything else is included regardless of whether it has a registration link.

events.title: Appalachian Dog Training - Puppy Socialization
events.description: Come get some puppy love!! A couple puppies will be hanging out at the farm for socialization this is just a visit if you are interested in getting some puppy love for the afternoon!

events.title: Pottery Create Your Ornaments 2 part series with Sophia
events.description: Nov 4th - Create Your Ornaments Part 1 of 2 We’ll start by working with clay to create your ornaments. No pottery experience is necessary! We’ll use cookie-cutter-style techniques, making it as easy and fun as cutting out sugar cookies.

events.title: Herbal Holiday Gift Making Part 1 with Rebecca
events.description: The holidays are the perfect time to share your love of herbs with your friends and family! Gifts you prepare yourself are often more meaningful than anything you can buy at the store.

events.title: Fly Tying for Beginners
events.description: Tying fishing flies to imitate various insects that live in our rivers and are favorite foods for trout is a fun hobby. You will feel a special exhilaration when a fish takes a fly you tied.

events.title: Open Pottery Studio with Sophia
events.description: Open Studio Pottery If you have taken a pottery session with us, or have prior pottery experience, register for our open studio. During this time, our resident potter Sophia will be present to help with any questions.

events.description: Empower, Engage, Enrich. A century of empowering women and enriching Henderson County through philanthropic and community service.

events.title: Woodworking 2 part workshop with Chris from Forest Project Woodworking
events.description: This is a 2 part workshop Join master furniture maker Chris to make your own woodworking project. Designed for adult beginners, these workshops introduce shop safety, wood selection, project build, sanding, and finishing.

events.title: Oyster Mushroom Cultivation Workshop
events.description: Learn about the lifecycle of mushrooms and how to grow oyster mushrooms yourself.

events.title: Veterans Quail Hunt (Veterans only)
events.description: 🦆 Veterans Quail Hunt. November 14! Mountain View Hunting Club in Del Rio, Tennessee, has generously invited our Veterans to join them for a guided quail hunt on Saturday, November 14, from 8:30 AM-3:30 PM.

events.title: Sourdough Discard with Patrina
events.description: Do you love sourdough? Ever wonder what to do with the leftover starter that you wind up with? Come and learn the many ways to put it to use. We will make crackers, chocolate bread, and other goodies using leftover soudough starter.

events.title: Appalachian Dog Training - Puppy socialization
events.description: Come get some puppy love!! This is a few hours of drop in puppy time to help teach them socialization. Feel free to come get some puppy snuggles!

events.title: Chair Massage with Lisa
events.description: A chair massage is a short, session focused on relieving tension in the neck, back, shoulders, arms, and hands. Sessions can be 15 or 30 minutes, it uses a specialized ergonomic chair to provide targeted acupressure and Swedish massage techniques.

events.title: Beeswax Candles with Jessica
events.description: A beeswax candle making workshop is a hands-on crafting class where participants learn to create eco-friendly, natural candles using pure beeswax from local hives

events.title: Woodworking 2 park workshop with Chris from Forest Project Woodworking
events.description: This is a 2 part workshop Join master furniture maker Chris to make your own woodworking project. Designed for adult beginners, these workshops introduce shop safety, wood selection, project build, sanding, and finishing.

events.title: Wreath Making with Maddie
events.description: We'll spread holiday cheer at the farm by making wreaths and holiday decor using natural products. Participants will learn the basics of wreath building and then supplement their wreaths with dried florals and textural elements grown in the VHF gardens.

events.title: Acupuncture with Daoist Clinic
events.description: The Daoist Traditions Acupuncture Clinic is located in Asheville NC. Their clinical interns are in the final phase of a rigorous four-year academic program and treat patients under the direct supervision of clinical faculty who are NC licensed acupuncturists.

events.title: Friendsgiving
events.description: Dear Friends of the Veterans Healing Farm, The season of gratitude is here, and we want to celebrate the incredible community that makes our farm so special. Please join us for an afternoon of good food, great company, and thanks. Of course family and friends are included!

events.title: Fruit Liquor making class with Patrina
events.description: Fruit liqueur making class Students will learn to make liqueurs from fresh fruits and other ingredients. We will be making white peach liqueur, blackberry liqueur, coffee liqueur and Irish cream liquor. These make great gifts or keep for yourself!
